intro.title: Welcome to the app tour!
intro.content: We're glad you're here. In this short tour, we'll show you how to use the app and what features it offers.

calendar.title: Calendar: Everything at a glance
calendar.content: To help us better understand your career path, [[strong:please add the activities]] you have carried out during the specified period to the calendar. Your activities will be automatically assigned to different areas of life. If necessary, you can pause the survey and continue later.

add-entry.title: New entry: Simply click or drag
add-entry.content: Alternatively, you can use the buttons [[icon:add-circle]] or [[button:Create new activity]].

add-episode.title: Create and save activity
add-episode.content: Select the [[strong:category]] of the activity (e.g., studies) from the drop-down menu and adjust the [[strong:date]] if necessary. Then click on [[button:Save]] and enter further activities.

continue-episode.title: Enter details for activities
continue-episode.content: By clicking on [[button:Continue to details]], you can directly enter [[strong:further information for this activity]]. If you skip this step, you can complete the detailed questions later by clicking on [[button:Continue editing]]. Activities that have not yet been edited are indicated by the shading and the [[icon:attention-bubble]].

calendar2.title: Edit or delete entries
calendar2.content: You can add [[strong:further activities to the calendar]], including those that take place simultaneously or overlap. If possible, make at least one entry each month. Entries that have already been created can be edited [[icon:edit-circle]] or deleted [[icon:delete-circle]] at any time.

table.title: Switch between calendar and list view
table.content: You can [[strong:switch between the calendar view and the list view]]. In the list view, you can filter your activities specifically – for example, by category or time period.

finish.title: Repeat tour
finish.content:
You can return to these instructions at any time by clicking the [[icon:help]] button.
Enjoy filling out!
